mintAuthority.summary: USX is dForce's native overcollateralized stablecoin with independent local MSDControllerV2 issuance paths on Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Polygon, Kava, and Avalanche. Each local controller has registered minters and mutable caps under a dForce Timelock/3-of-5 Safe path without an enforced execution delay; Arbitrum and Optimism bridge gateways are separate Bridge Risk machinery.

controls.label: USX Ethereum MSD token minter registry
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770675, the USX EIP-1967 proxy resolved to MSD implementation 0xe3ec7de9375bfc22f4481c4605431d67ed5bd260, proxy admin 0x4ff0455bcfbb5886607c078e0f43efb5de34def4, and getMinters() returned local MSDControllerV2 0x45677a101d70e9910c418d9426bc6c5874ce2fd7. MSD exposes mint(address,uint256) to registered minters; the controller enforces per-minter caps that its owner can change.

controls.label: USX Ethereum MSDControllerV2 minter admin
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770675, controller 0x45677a101d70e9910c418d9426bc6c5874ce2fd7 resolved to MSDControllerV2 implementation 0xd45a90376220237f18ef0b72f31d5683345566db with proxy admin 0x4ff0455bcfbb5886607c078e0f43efb5de34def4 and owner Timelock 0x17e66b1e0260c930bfa567ff3ab5c71794279b94. Its owner can add/remove local minters and set per-minter caps; -1 is uncapped.

controls.label: USX Ethereum token/controller ProxyAdmin
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770675, the same ProxyAdmin 0x4ff0455bcfbb5886607c078e0f43efb5de34def4 controlled the USX token proxy and MSDControllerV2 proxy. The token implementation was 0xe3ec7de9375bfc22f4481c4605431d67ed5bd260 and the controller implementation was 0xd45a90376220237f18ef0b72f31d5683345566db; the admin path is owned by the dForce Timelock.

controls.label: USX Ethereum dForce Timelock / token-owner executor
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770675, the local MSDControllerV2 owner and USX token owner path resolved to custom Timelock 0x17e66b1e0260c930bfa567ff3ab5c71794279b94, whose owner is Safe 0x145c79a1f0e1ad5ad7fc8d99548a02a07b24f8fd. The verified Timelock executes queued calls immediately with no enforced timestamp or ETA, so the Safe can authorize minter, cap, and upgrade changes without a delay.

review.evidence: At fixed observations on 2026-08-16, all eight catalogued USX token proxies resolved to the verified dForce MSD/controller pattern and each token's local getMinters() path included a local MSDControllerV2-family controller. The controllers have local minter registries and per-minter caps, while their owners are chain-local dForce Timelocks with no enforced timestamp/ETA. Seven Timelocks are owned by distinct 3-of-5 Safes with the documented five-owner set; Kava's owner 0x376e6832830ec117000df9106dd8e433e1d40d90 returned empty data for the Safe-compatible threshold read, so its multisig graph remains manual review. The local controllers can add/remove minters, change caps, and reserve-withdrawal logic can mint after its equity check; -1 denotes an uncapped minter. These native paths independently support a partially-bounded-admin posture with unbounded economic cap semantics, unknown whole-supply reconciliation, and no prudential supervision. The Arbitrum and Optimism gateways and configured Celer liquidity machinery are peripheral bridge controls and are excluded from this Mint Authority scope.
